figurative_meaning_en: A motley collection of people from various high and low castes or backgrounds
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গ্রামে ছত্রিশ জাতের মানুষ একসাথে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: People from all walks of life gathered at the fair.
The village is home to a diverse mix of communities living together.
note: Refers to the traditional Bengali social structure with multiple castes, often used to describe heterogeneous groups.
